reason: I would try a free tool that brings internship listings and application follow-ups together, and the project based application-material help sounds useful. I would only install it when I have time to deal with Docker, and I would skip optional AI if the provider cost is unclear.
objection: I don't want to spend an evening setting up a self-hosted app and then find out the job sources I need require paid keys.
would_change_my_mind: A quick-start path that shows which sources work for free and how much memory/setup it needs before I install.
